videos.title: Vitaly Laletin. The BEST Armwrestler in the World Right Now.
videos.summary:
Armwrestling world rankings: is Vitaly Laletin the best armwrestler in the world right now?

After East vs West 27, Vitaly Laletin is officially ranked number one in the world on both the left and right arm, the first man to hold the gauntlets on both hands. But the rankings are a mess, and the biggest open question is whether Levan could still beat him.

In this one I talk through:
- Why Vitaly's current form deserves the titles, even with his loss to Devon Larratt as super heavyweights a few months ago

- Their last meeting back in 2019 in Poland, where Levan's back pressure and pronation overwhelmed Vitaly's wrist

- How Vitaly has evolved: he no longer pronates first, he cups first, goes directly sideways, and only then brings in the pronation

- Why a six foot eight lever with static side pressure, wrist flexion and that bone angle is a biomechanical nightmare to attack, and why hooking him is a hard task

- What Levan would need to come back in the shape that beat Ermes Gasparini, and why he would still be the historical favourite

- Why Sagov beating Devon has thrown the rankings upside down, with no linear logic left between Sagov, Dave Chaffee, Petrenko and Devon

Left arm there is no doubt. Right arm, the only real questions are Levan and a Devon return to super heavyweight.

Do you think Vitaly is rightfully the best in the world, and would he beat Levan if Levan came back in his best form? Tell me in the comments.
